title: Org HC prep scratchpad - Elena Park
content:
PURPOSE:
- Quick working notes for upcoming headcount syncs + 1:1s. Use as my talking points and live action tracker during the meeting. Not customer-facing.

MEETINGS INCLUDED:
- HC weekly with Ravi (people lead) — cadence: weekly, goal: finalize Q1 hires + commit to offers
- 1:1 with Ria (Director, Product) — confirm hiring priorities and interviewers
- Post-interview debriefs to run after onsite loop this week

QUICK ASK / OPEN QUESTIONS (to surface early):
- Which reqs are "must-fill" vs "nice-to-fill" for Q1? (Ria to confirm)
- Any new budget constraints from finance that change level/comp targets? (Ravi update)
- Interviewer bandwidth: can we reserve dedicated panels next Tue/Thu? If not, propose async take-home + 1 live loop for final stage.

HEADCOUNT SNAPSHOT (live numbers to read out):
- Open reqs prioritized: 1) Senior Infra SWE (infra) — strong pipeline (6 active), target hire by end of Feb
  2) Applied ML Engineer (serving-runtime team) — pipeline thin (2 active), need recruiter blitz
  3) PM, Dedicated (product) — 4 active, ok
  4) Solutions Engineer (SE) — 8 active, but several passive in process
- Backfills: 2 (ops + finance) — lower priority
- Reserved slots for Dedicated customers pilot: 1-2 (tentative)

CANDIDATE RISKS / FLAGS:
- Applied ML candidate A: expecting above-range comp, remote-only (needs relocation/visa check) — flag for compensation approval
- Infra candidate B: counter-offer likely; has final loop with FAANG competitor next week
- SE pipeline: many candidates with product familiarity but limited LLM infra experience — need stronger screen question set

INTERVIEW LOOP / ASSIGNMENTS (this week's onsite):
- Loop format: 1 hr system design (infra), 45m coding (pair), 30m product collaboration, 30m role fit
- Interviewers assigned (tentative):
  - System design (infra): Samir P.
  - Coding: Aisha K.
  - Product collaboration: Ria
  - Role fit / org values: Me (Elena)
- Backup interviewers: Jordan L. (infra), Priya S. (product)

DEBRIEF TEMPLATE (use after each loop) — paste into debrief thread:
- Candidate: [name] | Role: [req] | Date/time: [ ]
- Overall score (1-5): [ ]
- Strengths (3 bullets): [ ]
- Risks / concerns (3 bullets): [ ]
- Hire recommendation: Strong Yes / Yes / Maybe / No
- Compensation expectation compared to band: Below / Mid / Above
- Required follow-ups: references / take-home / manager sync
- Decision owner: [hiring manager]

SCORING GUIDELINES (share-inline during calibration):
- 5: Clear top-quartile for role; immediate offer if comp approved and references clean
- 4: Strong hire; small concerns that are addressable via manager interview or references
- 3: Borderline — needs calibration; can be considered if other signals positive
- 2: Several gaps; only consider if strong org fit and cheap to hire
- 1: No hire

LOGISTICS / TIMING CONSTRAINTS:
- Offer target window for infra role: within 2 weeks of final loop to avoid losing to counter-offers
- Candidate notice periods: capture in ATS and mark heavy risk if >6 weeks
- Interviewer blackout days: Samir out 2/2–2/6; Aisha flexible afternoons next week

ACTION ITEMS (live tracker — short, owner, due):
- Recruiter: push Sourcing blitz for Applied ML req (Samir) — due: 2026-01-25
- Comp approval: budget check for Applied ML above-band request (Ravi) — due: 2026-01-20
- Interview pack: update infra system-design prompt to include LLM-specific KV/cache question (Elena) — due: 2026-01-19 (before onsite)
- Panel reserve: lock calendar for loop slots Tue/Thu (Elena to confirm with calendar admin) — due: 2026-01-18 (ASAP)
- Debrief template: post to #hiring-debriefs channel after each onsite (Elena) — ongoing

NOTES TO SELF / TALKING POINTS FOR 1:1 WITH RAVI:
- Emphasize trade-offs: we can delay 1 non-critical backfill and reallocate to Applied ML for product roadmap timing
- Ask Ravi for contingency authority: allow +10% comp flexibility for top Applied ML candidate to close quickly
- Confirm runway for external agency support if in-house sourcing doesn't fill by Feb 1

CALIBRATION REMINDERS BEFORE PANEL:
- Share rubric one hour before loop with interviewers (3 bullet examples of good/ok/bad answers)
- Remind interviewers to take notes directly in ATS debrief form (timestamped)
- Encourage panel to call out "red flags" early (visa, comp, missing core infra skill)

FOLLOW-UPS AFTER MEETING (my checklist):
- Update headcount tracker spreadsheet with any commit changes and send to Ravi + finance
- Fire off sourcing brief to external agency if approved
- Schedule short calibration sync (15m) for panel leads if majority are green/amber on a candidate

ROUGH SCRIPT FOR RIA 1:1 (to align priorities):
- Quick context: Q1 roadmap milestones that depend on Applied ML hire (2-3 sentences)
- Ask: which deliverable is highest priority and why? (force choice: infra vs model infra vs product PM)
- Trade-off: if we can only commit 2 hires this quarter, which two? (get explicit ranking)
- Interviewer ask: preference for onsite vs take-home practical? (Ria's bias matters for pass/fail signals)

POST-MEETING CAPTURE (what I will copy to candidate threads):
- Any immediate rejection reasons (must include explicit signals)
- If move to offer, capture proposed band and target comp, sign-off names

MISC NOTES / SCRATCH (random ideas):
- Consider short "band uplift" memo we circulate to hiring managers when comp needs escalate
- Create a one-pager for interviewers on LLM infra primitives we expect hires to know (KV cache, batching, quantization tradeoffs) — could reuse later for candidate prep
- Keep one shortlisted list of "fast-offer" candidates for secondaries in case top choice declines

END - will update live during the weekly HC sync and then prune to final action list.
